candidates.description: This feature vector represents abstract ideas, mental impressions, and subjective viewpoints.
This feature vector represents entities, systems, or representatives that act on behalf of others, prominently including artificial intelligence, software entities, and organizational operatives.
This vector is related to French determiners and quantifiers, particularly cardinal numbers and adjectives of quantity or possession.
This feature vector represents the concept of utility, practical application, and words related to "using" or "tools" primarily in French and English.
These tokens are common German nominal and adjectival suffixes or internal word fragments.
This feature activates for mathematical, structural, and electrical grid concepts related to arrays, networks, and circuits.
This vector represents common English surnames.
This feature vector activates on subwords, prefixes, and root forms related to containers, vessels, or enclosed protective units.
This vector represents common short male given names.
This feature vector represents various forms of media, entertainment, and artistic works.
